# =============================================================================
# QPX canonical candidate: full-oxygen seven-heavy-species transport database
#
# Active species:
#   O2 O2s O2p O Om Op Os
#
# Alias policy:
#   O2s -> O2
#   Os  -> O
#   O2p -> O2+
#   Op  -> O+
#   Om  -> O-
#
# Static-data policy:
#   neutral-neutral       : Mutation++ explicit Wright2005 tables
#   positive-ion-neutral  : Mutation++ explicit Levin2004 tables
#   negative-ion-neutral  : Mutation++ Langevin Q11, Wright2007 Q22=1.1 Q11
#                            with alpha(O)=0.80 A^3, alpha(O2)=1.58 A^3
#   charged-charged       : NO static tables here; QPX evaluates dynamic
#                            Debye-Huckel from local T, Te and ne.
#
# Q11/Q22 table convention:
#   values are stored in the Mutation++ multpi=yes numeric convention.
#   QPX converts each value to SI as value * pi * 1e-20 [m^2].
#
# Species molar-mass convention:
#   Preserve existing QPX oxygen transport convention 0.016/0.032 kg/mol.
#   This reproduces the prior R2 O- / O2 mobility benchmark.
# =============================================================================

species O2   0.032 O2
species O2s  0.032 O2
species O2p  0.032 O2+
species O    0.016 O
species Om   0.016 O-
species Op   0.016 O+
species Os   0.016 O
